articles.summary: Barrons.com: These Stocks Are Today’s Movers: JPMorgan, Delta, L3Harris, Intel, AMD, BNY Mellon, and More. Stock futures were falling Tuesday as investors digested quarterly results from JPMorgan Chase and Delta Air Lines both of which kicked off the earnings season. JPMorgan Chase rose 0.4%. Although the bank’s profit declined 7% in the fourth quarter, revenue rose on the back of higher fees and interest income. Related tickers mentioned: AMD, BK, DAL, GOOG, JPM.

articles.title: KeyBanc upgrades Intel and AMD on surging hyperscaler demand
articles.mainIdea: KeyBanc upgrades Intel and AMD on surging hyperscaler demand
articles.summary: Investing.com: KeyBanc upgrades Intel and AMD on surging hyperscaler demand. Investing.com -- KeyBanc Capital Markets has upgraded Intel and AMD to Overweight, citing stronger-than-expected data-center demand and tightening memory supply across the semiconductor industry. Related tickers mentioned: AAPL, AMD.

articles.title: Intel Stock Gains. Why the Chip Company and AMD Got Upgrades.
articles.mainIdea: Intel Stock Gains. Why the Chip Company and AMD Got Upgrades.
articles.summary: Barrons.com: Intel Stock Gains. Why the Chip Company and AMD Got Upgrades.. Intel and Advanced Micro Devices were gaining early on Monday. It’s set to be a good year for makers of central processing units, according to KeyBanc. Analyst John Vinh raised his rating on both Intel and AMD to Overweight, noting the companies appear to have largely sold out their server CPUs for this year amid the boom in artificial-intelligence infrastructure. Related tickers mentioned: AMD.
